channel.title: Small Business Deadline Calendar: vendor changes
channel.description: Dated vendor and system changes small businesses should check, each with its official source. General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Oct 16: Old Microsoft Whiteboards still in Azure are deleted
item.description:
Date: Oct 16, 2026
Who: Work or school accounts with Whiteboards not migrated to OneDrive
What to check: Check the 'Not migrated' section in Whiteboard and export what you need.
Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/whiteboard/migration-of-whiteboards-from-azure-to-onedrive

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Oct 26: ChatGPT Enterprise: new GPT creation ended (FedRAMP exempt)
item.description:
Date: Oct 26, 2026 (ended)
Who: Affected ChatGPT Enterprise workspaces. FedRAMP workspaces are exempt.
What to check: New GPT creation has ended. Edits to existing, unmigrated GPTs are still allowed. For new reusable workflows, OpenAI says to use Plugin Creator. A deferral alone does not preserve eligibility to create new GPTs.
Source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001519-custom-gpt-retirement-and-migration-faq

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 1: EU product identifiers become mandatory for low-value e-commerce imports
item.description:
Date: Nov 1, 2026
Who: Sellers outside the EU who ship online orders up to EUR 150 to EU consumers, and whoever declares those parcels
What to check: Check that every product variant has a unique code and a manufacturer code, and ask your carrier or customs agent what product data they need.
Source: https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/news/guidance-and-legal-text-temporary-flat-fee-low-value-imports-which-will-apply-until-1-july-2028-2026-06-08_en

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 1: IRS FIRE: last day for test files
item.description:
Date: Nov 1, 2026
Who: Businesses that e-file 1099s themselves through FIRE
What to check: Check who files your 1099s and which system they use.
Source: https://www.irs.gov/e-file-providers/filing-information-returns-electronically-fire

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 2: Amazon commercial liability insurance changes start
item.description:
Date: Nov 2, 2026
Who: Amazon sellers in categories with enhanced safety listing requirements; sellers based in Mainland China
What to check: Check whether your category is covered and whether your policy is on file with Amazon.
Source: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/seller-forums/discussions/t/287d5c33-8278-4802-ba69-2f58f7dda408

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 3: ZenBusiness Banking: deposits stop
item.description:
Date: Nov 3, 2026
Who: ZenBusiness Banking account holders
What to check: Check everything that pays into the account and send new bank details.
Source: https://help.zenbusiness.com/zenbusiness-banking/banking-closure-faq

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 9, 2026 was the last day to change FIRE IR Applications for TCC
item.description:
Date: Nov 9, 2026
Who: Businesses that file through FIRE
What to check: Nov 9, 2026 was the last day to make changes to FIRE IR Applications for TCC; those applications are now read-only. Check whether an IRIS Application for TCC is started (the IRS says current FIRE users must complete a separate IRIS Application for TCC).
Source: https://www.irs.gov/e-file-providers/filing-information-returns-electronically-fire

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 19: IRS FIRE: last day to file information returns (3 p.m. ET)
item.description:
Date: Nov 19, 2026
Who: Businesses that file 1099s through FIRE
What to check: Check for open corrections or late returns and ask your provider if they are on IRIS.
Source: https://www.irs.gov/e-file-providers/filing-information-returns-electronically-fire · https://www.irs.gov/filing/e-file-information-returns-with-iris

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 30: ZenBusiness Banking: accounts close
item.description:
Date: Nov 30, 2026
Who: ZenBusiness Banking account holders
What to check: Check balance moved, payments switched, debit card charges moved, mailing address current.
Source: https://help.zenbusiness.com/zenbusiness-banking/banking-closure-faq · https://help.zenbusiness.com/zenbusiness-banking/move-your-money-from-zenbusiness-banking

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Dec 11: ChatGPT custom GPTs scheduled to retire
item.description:
Date: Dec 11, 2026
Who: Anyone who created or relies on a custom GPT (FedRAMP workspaces and affected Enterprise workspaces with a deferral from OpenAI: Feb 11, 2027). A deferral alone does not preserve eligibility to create new GPTs.
What to check: List your GPTs, publish the version you want migrated (public sharing is not required), migrate the ones you created to plugins and test them. Custom actions do not transfer. In a managed workspace, Share Plugin can prefill the original GPT audience.
Source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001519-custom-gpt-retirement-and-migration-faq

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 2: Form 941 for the third quarter of 2026
item.description:
Date: Nov 2, 2026 (Nov 10, 2026 if the quarter's deposits were on time and in full)
Who: Employers who file Form 941
What to check: File third-quarter Form 941. Deposit FUTA owed through September if it is more than $500.
Source: https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/fourth-quarter-tax-calendar · https://www.irs.gov/publications/p509

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 4: eBay U.S. Payments Terms of Use take effect for sellers who have not already accepted them
item.description:
Date: Nov 4, 2026 (Oct 21, 2026 if you already accepted this version)
Who: eBay Managed Payments sellers who have not already accepted the October 21, 2026 terms
What to check: Read the Payments Terms PDF, finish eBay balance identity verification if it applies, and confirm your payout schedule in Seller Hub.
Source: https://ir.ebaystatic.com/cr/v/c01/us-payments-terms-of-use-2026-10-21b.pdf

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 1: Amazon.com holiday return window opens for purchases through Dec 31, 2026
item.description:
Date: Purchases Nov 1 through Dec 31, 2026; returns until Jan 31, 2027 (Apple brand products until Jan 15, 2027)
Who: Amazon.com sellers, FBA and FBM
What to check: Plan for the longer return window. Amazon says no setting change is required and existing return conditions stay the same.
Source: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/seller-forums/discussions/t/fcc4e6f3-5e86-4b04-be84-82f9bcc2558a

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Dec 15: Federal small-business tax payments
item.description:
Date: Dec 15, 2026
Who: Calendar-year corporations, partnerships that file Form 8813, and monthly employment-tax depositors
What to check: Match your entity to the IRS line before you pay. Sole proprietors' next individual estimated-tax date under Publication 509 is Jan 15, 2027, not Dec 15.
Source: https://www.irs.gov/publications/p509 · https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/fourth-quarter-tax-calendar

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Jan 4, 2027: Pennsylvania annual report enforcement applies to reports due on or after this date
item.description:
Date: Jan 4, 2027 is the statutory start, not the filing day. Corporations file by June 30, LLCs by September 30, and limited partnerships, limited liability partnerships, business trusts, and professional associations by December 31.
Who: Most domestic and foreign Pennsylvania filing associations. Not a sole proprietor who is not an LLC, and not a general partnership that is not a limited liability partnership.
What to check: File the 2027 annual report on file.dos.pa.gov. The Department of State lists a $7 fee, or $0 for a nonprofit corporation and for a limited partnership or LLC with a not-for-profit purpose. A missed 2027 report can lead to administrative dissolution, cancellation, or termination six months after the due date, after notice.
Source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dos/programs/business/types-of-filings-and-registrations/annual-reports

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Jan 29, 2027: Texas franchise tax forfeiture and reinstatement
item.description:
Date: Revive the right to transact business before Jan 29, 2027. The Comptroller began mailing the Texas Notice of Forfeiture of Right to Transact Business on Sept 29, 2026.
Who: Texas taxable entities that have not satisfied franchise tax filing or payment requirements.
What to check: File the missing report or information report and pay any tax, penalty, and interest. If the Secretary of State has forfeited the registration, request Comptroller Form 05-391, then file Secretary of State Form 801 ($75, or no fee for a nonprofit corporation).
Source: https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/tax-policy-news/2026-october.php · https://www.sos.state.tx.us/corp/instructions/801.shtml

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Apr 1, 2027: Exchange Online EWS fully and permanently disabled
item.description:
Date: Apr 1, 2027 (phased switch-off rolls out tenant by tenant from Oct 2026)
Who: Microsoft 365 admins whose apps, scripts or services still use EWS
What to check: Review EWS usage reports, read EWSEnabled and your AppID allow list (read-only), and move apps to Microsoft Graph. Microsoft says there will be no exceptions past April 2027.
Source: https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/exchange/exchange-online-ews-your-time-is-almost-up/4492361

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.
